title: Inversion of the Pair Decoder
statement: For every finite Boolean word $z$ and all finite Boolean words $a,b$, if decoding $z$ yields the pair $(a,b)$, then $z$ is the self-delimiting pair encoding of $a$ and $b$.
replaced: For every binary string $z$ and all strings $a, b$: if the self-delimiting pair decoder returns the pair $(a, b)$ on $z$, then $z$ is exactly the pair encoding of $(a, b)$.
